btn-caps.covers: every filled or outlined button and every link styled as a button: hero CTAs, form submits, newsletter Subscribe, ticket buy, MENU, header Join a society

t-label.covers: eyebrows, fact labels (Meets, Venue, Founded), pills, table heads

t-num.covers: dates, times, prices, codes, /media-kit hex values
t-num.note: size, weight and case follow the surrounding role; only the family and the numeric variant are set by this role

textLinksNavBreadcrumbs: Text links, nav links, breadcrumbs and arrow links keep sentence case (C3).
pillsAndFilterChips: Filter chips, toggles, tabs and other aria-pressed/role=tab controls are PILLS (t-label), not buttons (btn-caps). Open question to NOS Design if they disagree.
classNames: t-label / t-crumb / t-num / t-field / btn-caps are the architect's names, defined once in app/globals.css (@layer components). @dev may not rename them; the checks key on them.
